nodes.name: Two-step thermal treatment for Co-NRCNTs
nodes.procedure: A mixture of dicyandiamide and CoCl₂·6H₂O was heated at 500°C in N₂ atmosphere to form Co²⁺-functionalized graphitic carbon nitride (Co²⁺-g-C₃N₄). The as-formed Co²⁺-g-C₃N₄ was pyrolyzed at 700°C, followed by acid etching to remove any accessible cobalt species on the NPs.

unit_operations.name: Thermal treatment
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: mixture of dicyandiamide and CoCl₂·6H₂O was heated at 500°C in N₂ atmosphere to form Co²⁺-g-C₃N₄

unit_operations.name: Pyrolysis and etching
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: as-formed Co²⁺-g-C₃N₄ was pyrolyzed at 700°C, followed by acid etching to remove any accessible cobalt species

nodes.source_text: Zou et al. first synthesized the Co-embedded nitrogen-rich CNTs through a simple two-step thermal treatment: (1) a mixture of dicyandiamide and CoCl₂·6H₂O was heated at 500°C in N₂ atmosphere... (2) as-formed Co²⁺-g-C₃N₄ was pyrolyzed at 700°C, followed by acid etching
